EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT,
(CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: DS/GFG/L&L/5/2014/07. Land Mini. stry. Ref. No.: 4-3/12/2014/UD/239A.

I, hereby give Notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below for a public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired:

Twenty One (21) allotments of land in Total Extent 0.1603 Hectare depicted as Lots 162, 163, 166, 167, 168, 169, 172, 173, 175, 176, 179, 180, 183, 184, 187, 188, 191, 192, 195, 196 and 199 in Sheet No. 4, Block No. 02 of Cadastral Map No. 810013 prepared by the Surveyor General Situated in the Village of Makuluwa in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 99C of Makuluwa within the Municipal Council Limit of Galle in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Four Gravets Galle in Galle District of the Southern Province and Bounded as follows.

Claimant: Marikkara Badurdeen Fathuma Sakkiya, Bandaranayake Place, Makuluwa, Galle (Occupied by Galle) ; Extent: about 0.0016 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/servitude on which a servitude is to be acquired are herby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Galle Four Gravets on 30th September, 2016 at 09.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 23rd September, 2016 the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the
said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. All deeds and documents in support of the claims should be produced before me at the inquiry.
W. S. SATHYANANDA, Divisional Secretary, Galle Four Gravets. 14th September, 2016. 09 - 1100
